name: Audio Track Priority
description: Picks the default audio and subtitle track by their Title field when several tracks share the same ISO language code, such as a Quebec French (VFQ) dub next to a France French (VFF) dub, both tagged "fra". Define, per language, an ordered list of title patterns and Jellyfin will default to the first match. No media file is modified.
overview: Default audio and subtitle track selection by track title, per language.

versions.changelog: In "Same" subtitle mode, no full subtitle track is chosen when the audio track that will play is already in the preferred language; a real forced track (forced flag, or "forced" / "forcé" in its title) is still chosen, and a full default track set by Jellyfin itself in that language is cleared. Other audio languages: unchanged.
Per-rule "Prefer a Forced subtitle track" setting (previously a single global checkbox).
